It's determined by a combination of the artifact's material type and its environmental sensitivity level. Specifically, artifacts made of 'Wood', 'Textile', or 'Paper' that have a 'High' environmental sensitivity are classified as 'Vulnerable'; all others are 'Non-Vulnerable'.
